lede: The one meeting worth circling this week is the San Miguel County Planning Commission on September 10th, where commissioners will weigh in on three Land Use Code amendments touching forestry practices, oil and gas, and geothermal energy — their recommendations go to the BOCC, so this is the public's best early shot at influencing how those rules get written. Meanwhile, the Town of Telluride's September 10th budget session has been pushed to October 13th, and the Norwood Water Commission has moved its meeting to September 22nd, so check your calendars if you had those on your radar.

notable.stake: Three Land Use Code amendments — forestry, oil/gas, geothermal — up for Planning Commission recommendation.
